acceptance: AE44 (semantic locations, obligation explanations and safe fixes)

behavior_contracts.AE44/codes: Each obligation class carries a stable code: CAN-CHECK-MISSING-ARM, CAN-CHECK-OUTWARD-ERROR, CAN-CHECK-FIXTURE-USE, CAN-CHECK-FIXTURE-DEFINITION, CAN-CHECK-EXACT-SPECIALIZATION, CAN-CHECK-CAPTURE, CAN-CHECK-BOUND-CYCLE. stampCode classifies deeper spans without disturbing inner obligations; the lexical CAN-LEX-PUNCTUATION control is unchanged.
behavior_contracts.AE44/explanations: Outward errors name the declared emits bound; fixture uses name expected params/types; capture failures name the capture, declaring callable and exact expected type; ambiguity lists every exact specialization as readable name plus exact identity.
behavior_contracts.AE44/secondary: Missing arms link the invocation; outward errors link the region; fixture uses link the definition across files; ambiguity links the matched bound/policy; cycles link every pending declaration in the chain.
behavior_contracts.AE44/fixes: Only missing forward/void-success arms propose insert-only fixes, each re-checked by the checker before surfacing and by ValidateFix against an isolated overlay snapshot before presentation. Emits widening, error suppression, ownership changes and guessed values are omitted, never proposed.
